versions.localizedDescription:
**YTKACE v0.8.3**
by @itzzace0

**What's new:**
• Updated for YouTube 21.32.4
• Added Japanese localization
• Expanded localization across all 15 supported languages

**Fixed:**
• Improved Cast discovery and behavior after relaunching YouTube
• Removed expensive Cast scanning that caused launch and feed lag
• Reworked ad filtering for smoother feed scrolling
• Reduced unnecessary playback processing and battery usage
• Stopped SponsorBlock processing when the feature is disabled
• Fixed missing translations throughout settings, downloads, players, and menus

**Jailbreak repo:** `https://itzzace.github.io/ytkace/`
Rootless and roothide packages, plus a page with an Add to Sileo button.

**What's New**
- Sleep timer button in the player overlay, using YouTube's own menu and status bar. End of video shows the remaining video time and stops playback when it runs out.
- Remove Frosted Tab Bar.
- Remove Products now covers the feed, the player and Shorts under a single toggle.

**Fixed**
- Hide Cast doing nothing when YouTube's language wasn't English.
- Download button misaligned in the player overlay in non-English languages.
